Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Weather and Climate Prediction | NVIDIA Blog
Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions.
NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data.
Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research.
StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data.
Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data.

AXA is using NVIDIA Earth-2’s FourCastNet 3 to study regional cyclone risk beyond the historical record across more than 1,000 simulated seasons, generating insights that can inform risk assessments and help customers target prevention efforts.

Vaisala Xweather is combining Earth-2 with its proprietary observations , lightning data and forecasting expertise to enhance its weather intelligence platforms for government, energy, maritime, transportation and insurance customers.

TotalEnergies is exploring NVIDIA Earth-2 for solar-energy forecasting, evaluating StormScope-based solar-radiation nowcasts at two photovoltaic sites and developing models to provide weather information at subhourly intervals.
Explore NVIDIA Earth-2 open models and tools , and explore with Earth2Studio’s forecasting examples .
